definition.carrier: mover residuals at an exact canonical state
definition.capSet: top-row cap cell of every non-full column
definition.holeResidual: mover residual equal to capSet with exactly one cap removed
definition.bit: defined only when exactly one holeResidual exists; 1 iff the missing cap is incident to another mover residual, else 0
definition.covariance: all audited defined endpoints verified under every column permutation
